source_document.title: AMB2025-06 and AMB2025-07 Benchmark Measurements and Challenge Problems

source_scope: Values transcribed from the publicly accessible NIST challenge-description PDF. This is not a downloaded mds2-3707 measurement payload or a reconstruction from TIFF masks.

specimen_and_process.substrate: bare plate, rolled and annealed sheet, 3.17 mm thick
specimen_and_process.diameter_definition: 2D Gaussian power-profile regression; equivalent to D4sigma for a perfect Gaussian

measurement_operator.method: MATLAB R2024a Segment Anything Model segmentation with small manual mask cleanup
measurement_operator.surface_reference: horizontal line drawn by hand at plate surface
measurement_operator.total_height_um: segmented bounding-box height across the reference surface
measurement_operator.bead_height_um: segmented extent above the reference surface
measurement_operator.depth_um: segmented extent below the reference surface
measurement_operator.uncertainty: NIST did not calculate an uncertainty budget for image-segmentation results; published sample standard deviations are retained.

intended_use: Calibration target candidate for a single-track bare-plate IN718 thermal-model study, after explicitly defining a solidified-pool observation operator and fixed parameter set.
limitations: Calibration data, not an independent holdout.
The reported operator measures solidified etched geometry; a simulated liquidus contour is not yet shown to be equivalent.
Image-segmentation uncertainty budget was not calculated.
The direct 29.2 kB mask download timed out with zero bytes; no raw PDR payload is included here.
No solver comparison or physical validation is claimed by this transcription.
